answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 47155 Country: Pakistan Title: Regarding Mammary Intercouse Question: Can I do mammary intercourse with my wife? This sex act involves the man placing his penis in the woman's cleavage and thrusting between her breasts, while the breasts are squeezed around the penis for additional stimulation. Answer ID: 47155 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1349/1327/N=11/1434) Shariah has allowed a man to enjoy all the parts of his wife except her back side. There is no evidence that enjoying any specific part except backside is prohibited. If any husband does mammary intercourse with his wife then it is allowed as per the Shariah, but there are some Fiqh scholars who prohibit this. (Shami, Vol. 3, p 371, published by: Maktaba Zakaria Deoband) Therefore, one should avoid it as long as one can and should enjoy it only in the time of need i.e. when the wife is experiencing her menses and the sexual desire of husband is highly aroused. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
